title: Artifact
description: An immutable derived result (D9): a transcript, OCR text, summary, rendition, overlay or web snapshot. Rerunning a job makes a new Artifact; the Hub owns which one is current per (subject_ref, artifact_type). It can be rerun from the recorded inputs, but the result may differ, so it is backed up. The body is the content Blob: a text body (extraction; #8's types later) is JSON in the artifact/body envelope, narrowed by its type's body schema, and a rendition's is the rendered PDF itself, with no envelope; artifact_type, subject_ref (blob:<original>) and pipeline_version say what it renders. A web_snapshot is the page the Hub fetched from its subject Capture's url, the response body as received and no envelope either; it is not the Attachment role web_snapshot (a copy a client uploaded) nor the Locator kind (a place in such a Blob). Its effective cloud_policy is min of its inputs, computed at each provider call and not stored (D8). An Artifact with no input Blob (web_snapshot) takes its subject Capture's policy (#8). The Hub writes every column. Open: clients ignore members they do not know.

artifact_type.description: Known types are the examples; a newer Hub may send others, which a client keeps but does not interpret.

subject_ref.description: What the Artifact was made for.

job_key.description: The ProcessingJob's job_key (D4) as lowercase hex SHA-256: the same key reuses this Artifact.

provider.description: The provider that ran the model; absent for a job without one, such as a rendition.

model.description: The model; absent for a job without one.

prompt_version.description: The prompt's version; absent for a job without a prompt.

input_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every input: Blobs, and other Artifacts by their content Blob. Empty for a job that reads none, such as a web_snapshot fetch, whose input is its subject Capture's url.

content_blob.description: The Artifact's body: for extraction, JSON in artifact/extraction, its bytes canonical_json(body); for a rendition, the rendered PDF Blob itself, the Blob annotations are pinned to (D12); for a web_snapshot, the response body bytes as received, the Blob a web_snapshot Locator anchors (D13).

created_at.description: When the job recorded it; for a web_snapshot, when the page was fetched.

fetched.description: What a web_snapshot fetch ended at: the URL after redirects and the response's media type without parameters. Only a 200 response is kept, so there is no status code. The Capture keeps the url the user gave.

allOf.description: A type derived from Blobs names them: a purge finds what it removes by input_hashes and content_blob (D2).
